senior_deduction_sunset.label: Senior deduction ends after 2028
senior_deduction_sunset.description: P.L. 119-21 allows the $6,000 deduction for taxable years 2025 through 2028.

ss_trust_fund_shortfall.label: Social Security pays 78% of scheduled benefits from 2033
ss_trust_fund_shortfall.description: The 2026 Trustees Report projects the retirement trust fund's reserves run out in late 2032, after which income covers 78% of benefits.
